name: Bitcoin Icons
about: Bitcoin Icons is a free, open-source icon set with 330 icons designed by Bitcoin Design Community. Covers popular cryptocurrencies and payment symbols for fintech apps and dashboards. Every icon is available as SVG, PNG and WebP, or as a copy-paste React / TypeScript component or CDN link. Recolor and resize each one in the browser before you export – free, no account needed. Licensed under MIT.

faqs.q: Are Bitcoin Icons free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All 330 Bitcoin Icons are open source under the MIT license – free to download, customize and use. Always check the MIT terms for attribution or commercial-use requirements.

faqs.q: Which coins do Bitcoin Icons cover?
faqs.a: Popular cryptocurrencies and payment symbols for fintech apps and dashboards. Search a coin or token name above to check that it's included.

faqs.q: How do I use Bitcoin Icons in React or my website?
faqs.a: Copy any icon as a React / TypeScript component straight into your project, or paste the CDN link into your HTML. Every icon also downloads as SVG, PNG or WebP, and you can recolor and resize it in the browser before you export.

faqs.q: How many Bitcoin Icons are there?
faqs.a: There are 330 icons in the Bitcoin Icons set, designed by Bitcoin Design Community. Use the search above to find any icon by name.

faqs.q: What formats are Bitcoin Icons available in?
faqs.a: SVG, PNG and WebP downloads, copy-paste React / TypeScript components, plus a CDN link for every single icon – free, no account needed.
